doc.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: My Back Yard and Your Mind Is On Vacation
summary: Audre links My Back Yard to his meditative sitting; Your Mind Is On Vacation came from talkers at the Showboat.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well, this one, “My Back Yard,” Mose used to, at some time during every day, sit in the back yard. I called him “Little Buddha.”
there’s a nice photo of you sitting in the back yard with a book. Your legs are crossed, you’re reading a book, you have a hat on...
He used to sit like this, and stare at the trees and birds—a meditative kind of thing that I thought that song sort of came from.
Let me look at the song list, and throw it out there, and see what we come up with.
“Your Mind Is On Vacation.” Is that based on your experiences in loud nightclubs, or...
Well, that was based on the Showboat in Washington, D.C. That’s when I got the idea. People were talking during a performance, you know.
I guess you came up with a retort you can give them any time. Like that! “Your mind is on vacation.”
Just like that, there’s that song.
